FROM
  (
    -- 7-day window: 2021-01-01 through 2021-01-07 inclusive
    SELECT
      user_pseudo_id,
      SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(engagement_time_msec, 0), 0)) AS sum_engagement_7d
    FROM

    WHERE

    GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  ) AS seven

    SELECT
      user_pseudo_id,

WITH customers_who_bought_product_cohort AS (

  CAST(fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS fullVisitorId,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS date,
  visitId,
  h.hitNumber AS hitNumber
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p ON TRUE
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName <> ''
)
SELECT
  itm.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  SUM(COALESCE(itm.productQuantity, 1)) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS itm
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND s.fullVisitorId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
    FROM customers_who_bought_product_cohort
    WHERE product_name = "Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley"
      AND date BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'

WITH sessions_2017 AS (
  SELECT
    trafficSource.source AS source,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
    SAFE_CAST(totals.transactionRevenue AS INT64) AS transactionRevenue
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_source_rev AS (
  SELECT
    source,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM session_date) AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM session_date) AS month,
    SUM(transactionRevenue) AS month_transaction_revenue
  FROM sessions_2017
  GROUP BY source, year, month
),
yearly_source_rev AS (
  SELECT
    source,
    SUM(month_transaction_revenue) AS year_transaction_revenue
  FROM monthly_source_rev
  GROUP BY source
),
ranked_sources AS (
  SELECT
    y.source,
    y.year_transaction_revenue,

),
top_source_month_stats AS (

    MAX(m.month_transaction_revenue) AS max_month_rev,

  FROM monthly_source_rev m
  WHERE m.source = (SELECT source FROM ranked_sources WHERE rn = 1)
  GROUP BY m.source

FROM

CROSS JOIN

SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  DATE(first_visit_date) AS first_visit_date,
  DATE(first_transaction_date) AS first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(DATE(first_transaction_date), DATE(first_visit_date), DAY) AS days_between_first_visit_and_first_transaction,
  first_transaction_device
FROM (
  -- compute per visitor their first visit date in Feb 2017 and first transaction date in Feb 2017 with device of that first transaction
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) AS first_visit_date,
    MIN(txn_date) AS first_transaction_date,
    -- device of the first transaction: pick device for the session whose txn_date = first_transaction_date and transaction happened,
    -- if multiple sessions on same date take the earliest visitStartTime
    ARRAY_AGG(transaction_device ORDER BY txn_date, visitStartTime LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS first_transaction_device
  FROM (
    -- flatten sessions and extract sessions that are visits in Feb 2017 and sessions that contain transactions in Feb 2017
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      date,
      visitStartTime,
      -- device info for the session
      device.deviceCategory AS device_category,
      device.browser AS device_browser,
      device.operatingSystem AS device_os,
      -- construct a compact device string for the first-transaction device
      CONCAT(IFNULL(device.deviceCategory,''), ' / ', IFNULL(device.browser,''), ' / ', IFNULL(device.operatingSystem,'')) AS transaction_device,
      -- determine if this session has at least one transaction and what date that transaction is (session date)
      -- transactions can be recorded on hits.transaction.transactionId; treat any session with hits.transaction.transactionId not NULL as a transaction session
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
          WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
        ) THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS txn_date
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  )
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
  HAVING first_transaction_date IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY fullVisitorId

  ROUND(max_daily_millions, 3) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,

      UNNEST(h.item) AS item

    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    GROUP BY
      source, day, h.hitNumber, h.time, h.hour, h.minute
  ),
  -- The above approach with JOIN in FROM/UNNEST can duplicate rows; safer approach: extract revenues by unnesting items and products separately and union.
  item_revenue_by_day AS (
    SELECT
      trafficSource.source AS source,
      PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS day,

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h,
    UNNEST(h.item) AS item
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    GROUP BY source, day
  ),
  product_revenue_by_day AS (
    SELECT
      trafficSource.source AS source,
      PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS day,
      SUM(IFNULL(p.productRevenue, 0)) AS revenue
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,

    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    GROUP BY source, day
  ),
  daily_source_revenue AS (
    -- combine item and product revenues per source/day
    SELECT source, day, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
    FROM (

      SELECT * FROM product_revenue_by_day

  ),

    SELECT
      source,
      SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
      MAX(revenue) AS max_daily_revenue
    FROM daily_source_revenue
    GROUP BY source
  ),
  -- weekly and monthly aggregations per source
  weekly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
      source,
      FORMAT_DATE('%G-%V', day) AS iso_year_week,

    FROM daily_source_revenue

    SELECT

  source_weekly_max AS (

    FROM weekly_revenue
    GROUP BY source
  ),
  source_monthly_max AS (
    SELECT source, MAX(month_revenue) AS max_monthly_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue

  )
  SELECT

    sa.total_revenue / 1000000.0 AS total_revenue_millions,
    sa.max_daily_revenue / 1000000.0 AS max_daily_millions,
    swm.max_weekly_revenue / 1000000.0 AS max_weekly_millions,

  LEFT JOIN source_weekly_max AS swm USING(source)

SELECT
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS month_date,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX)) AS month,
  purchase_flag,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(pageviews), COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId)) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor
FROM (
  SELECT
    _TABLE_SUFFIX,
    fullVisitorId,
    -- session-level pageviews from totals.pageviews
    COALESCE(totals.pageviews, 0) AS pageviews,
    -- classify sessions:
    -- purchase: totals.transactions >= 1 AND there exists at least one hit.product with productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    -- non-purchase: totals.transactions IS NULL AND no hit.product.productRevenue present (or all null)
    CASE
      WHEN totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions >= 1
           AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
             WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
           )
        THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN totals.transactions IS NULL
           AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
             WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
           )
        THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS purchase_flag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
WHERE purchase_flag IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY month_date, month, purchase_flag
ORDER BY month_date, purchase_flag

SELECT
  COALESCE(next_page, '(no next page)') AS next_page_after_home,
  COUNT(1) AS sessions_count,
  MAX(time_on_home_seconds) AS max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM (
  SELECT
    CONCAT(fullVisitorId, CAST(visitId AS STRING)) AS session_key,
    -- identify the index/order of hits within the session and find the first hit whose pagePath starts with '/home'
    ARRAY(
      SELECT AS STRUCT h.hitNumber, h.time, h.page.pagePath
      FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      ORDER BY h.hitNumber
    ) AS ordered_hits,
    -- find the first hit index that's a /home hit
    (SELECT h.hitNumber FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
     WHERE SAFE_PREFIX(h.page.pagePath, 5) = '/home'
     ORDER BY h.hitNumber LIMIT 1) AS home_hit_number,
    -- the pagePath of the first home hit
    (SELECT h.page.pagePath FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
     WHERE SAFE_PREFIX(h.page.pagePath, 5) = '/home'
     ORDER BY h.hitNumber LIMIT 1) AS home_page_path,
    -- pagePath of the hit immediately after the first home hit (if any)
    (SELECT h_next.page.pagePath FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h_next
     WHERE h_next.hitNumber = (
       SELECT MIN(h2.hitNumber) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h2
       WHERE h2.hitNumber > (
         SELECT h3.hitNumber FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h3
         WHERE SAFE_PREFIX(h3.page.pagePath,5) = '/home'
         ORDER BY h3.hitNumber LIMIT 1
       )
     )
     LIMIT 1) AS next_page,
    -- compute time spent on the /home hit as difference in hit.times between the home hit and the next hit in seconds;
    -- if no next hit, use totals.timeOnSite as an upper-bound fallback (converted from seconds if present), else NULL
    (SELECT
       IF(
         EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h2 WHERE h2.hitNumber = home_hit_number) = FALSE,
         NULL,
         IF(
           (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h_after WHERE h_after.hitNumber > home_hit_number) = 0,
           -- no subsequent hit: fallback to totals.timeOnSite when available (already seconds)
           IFNULL(totals.timeOnSite, NULL),
           -- else compute time difference between next hit and home hit using their hit.time fields (milliseconds resolution)
           DIV(
             (SELECT CAST(hn.time AS INT64) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS hn WHERE hn.hitNumber = (
               SELECT MIN(hn2.hitNumber) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS hn2 WHERE hn2.hitNumber > home_hit_number
             )) -
             (SELECT CAST(h_home.time AS INT64) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h_home WHERE h_home.hitNumber = home_hit_number),
             1000
           )
         )
       )
     ) AS time_on_home_seconds
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h WHERE SAFE_CONTAINS_SUBSTR(h.page.pagePath, '/home') OR SAFE_PREFIX(h.page.pagePath,5) = '/home'
    )
    AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
)
-- keep only sessions that actually had a /home hit
WHERE home_hit_number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY next_page
ORDER BY sessions_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(AVG(purchase_pageviews_per_visitor), 2) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor_purchase,
  ROUND(AVG(non_purchase_pageviews_per_visitor), 2) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor_non_purchase
FROM (
  -- For each month and visitor, compute total pageviews for purchase and non_purchase sessions separately
  SELECT
    month,
    fullVisitorId,
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN session_pageviews END), 0) AS purchase_pageviews_per_visitor,
    IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN session_pageviews END), 0) AS non_purchase_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM (
    -- For each session compute its month, classification and pageviews
    SELECT
      FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(visitStartTime)) AS month,
      fullVisitorId,
      CASE WHEN EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
      ) THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END AS classification,
      totals.pageviews AS session_pageviews
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
      AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY month, fullVisitorId
)
-- Now for each month compute the average across visitors of their per-visitor totals in each classification
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT
  MAX(days_between) AS max_days_between
FROM (
  WITH all_events AS (
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS event_date,
      device.isMobile AS is_mobile,
      -- consider visitStartTime as event time for visit; transaction time not available, so use event_date
      totals.transactions AS transactions,
      -- for ordering visits per user
      visitStartTime
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
      AND fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL
  ),

  -- compute first visit date per user
  first_visit AS (
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      MIN(event_date) AS first_visit_date
    FROM all_events
    GROUP BY fullVisitorId
  ),

  -- compute last visit date per user (last recorded visit)
  last_visit AS (
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      MAX(event_date) AS last_visit_date
    FROM all_events
    GROUP BY fullVisitorId
  ),

  -- compute first transaction date per user (if any)
  first_transaction AS (
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      MIN(event_date) AS first_transaction_date
    FROM all_events
    WHERE COALESCE(transactions, 0) > 0
    GROUP BY fullVisitorId
  ),

  -- determine for each user which is the "last recorded event" (either last visit or first transaction),
  -- and whether that event was on a mobile device. To know device for that event, join back to events.
  candidate_last_event AS (
    SELECT
      fv.fullVisitorId,
      fv.first_visit_date,
      -- choose last_event_date as the later of last_visit_date and first_transaction_date where first_transaction_date IS NOT NULL,
      CASE
        WHEN ft.first_transaction_date IS NOT NULL AND ft.first_transaction_date > lv.last_visit_date THEN ft.first_transaction_date
        ELSE lv.last_visit_date
      END AS last_event_date,
      -- flag whether the chosen last event was on mobile by checking existence of an event for that user on that date with is_mobile = TRUE
      CASE
        WHEN ft.first_transaction_date IS NOT NULL AND ft.first_transaction_date > lv.last_visit_date
          THEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM all_events e
            WHERE e.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
              AND e.event_date = ft.first_transaction_date
              AND e.is_mobile = TRUE
          )
        ELSE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM all_events e
            WHERE e.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
              AND e.event_date = lv.last_visit_date
              AND e.is_mobile = TRUE
          )
      END AS last_event_is_mobile
    FROM first_visit fv
    JOIN last_visit lv ON fv.fullVisitorId = lv.fullVisitorId
    LEFT JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
  )

  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    first_visit_date,
    last_event_date,
    DATE_DIFF(last_event_date, first_visit_date, DAY) AS days_between,
    last_event_is_mobile
  FROM candidate_last_event
  WHERE last_event_is_mobile = TRUE
)
